blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from Muse's presale list (2026-11-01). Prices appear only where the source dates them within three months. Paragon presale data is still to be merged, and projects sold through private channels may be missing.
South Surrey presale projects on my list

Three projects on my list sit in the South Surrey area, going by the locations the sources give: Calais at Semiahmoo Town Centre, Rockford at 128 Street and 17 Avenue in Ocean Park, and Harlowe at 16485 18 Avenue, described by its sources as Sunnyside Heights and Grandview Heights. All three are scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2028.

faq.a: No. The page's own editorial says the listings "show newer and new-build homes wherever they are in South Surrey and White Rock", and the cards read include a nearly-new resale condo (Willow at King & Crescent), a resale unit in a sold-out completed tower (Foster Martin), move-in-ready completed stock (Fox & Aikins South) and a true presale (Harlowe, with an estimated early-2028 completion in its listing text). The feed held 122 listings at reading.
faq.q: Are all the homes on this page presales?

faq.a: The page states (site copy) that a qualifying new principal residence up to $1,100,000 is exempt from property transfer tax under BC's Newly Built Home Exemption (partial to $1,150,000), and that the federal First-Time Home Buyers' GST Rebate can return up to 100% of the 5% GST on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000). Verify both against the Province and the Canada Revenue Agency for your own purchase — neither threshold was opened on an official page in this pass.
faq.q: Do I pay property transfer tax and GST on a new South Surrey home?

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in South Surrey New Construction & Presales?

faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
